topic: Infection control, disease transmission, and workplace safety
author: codex-authoring-run-2026-08-13-infection-02

why: Some bacteria have thin tail-like flagella that move back and forth. This movement pushes the bacterial cell through liquid.
有些细菌带有细长尾状的 flagella（鞭毛）。鞭毛来回运动，推动细菌在液体中移动。
lock: flagella = tails that move some bacteria.
flagella = 帮助某些细菌移动的尾状结构。

why: A contagious disease can pass from one person to another. It may spread through touch, shared objects, droplets, or air.
contagious disease（传染病）可从一个人传给另一个人，可能通过接触、共用物品、飞沫或空气传播。
lock: contagious = can spread person to person.
contagious = 能在人与人之间传播。

why: A used towel can hold skin material, product, and germs from one client. Replace it with a clean towel before the next client.
用过的毛巾可能带有上一位客户的皮屑、产品和细菌。下一位客户前必须换成干净毛巾。
lock: every client = fresh clean towels.
每位客户 = 使用干净新毛巾。
refs: Infection Control - Linens and Single-Use Materials

why: Sodium hypochlorite is the active germ-killing chemical in household chlorine bleach. Bleach must be mixed and used only as its label directs.
sodium hypochlorite（次氯酸钠）是家用含氯漂白剂中的有效杀菌成分。必须按标签说明配制和使用。
lock: sodium hypochlorite = chlorine bleach ingredient.
次氯酸钠 = 含氯漂白剂成分。

why: Immunity is the body's defense against germs that cause disease. It recognizes threats and helps destroy them before or during infection.
immunity（免疫力）是身体对抗致病细菌的防御能力，能识别威胁，并在感染前后帮助清除它们。
lock: immunity = body's disease defense.
immunity = 身体抵抗疾病的能力。

why: Stopping immediately prevents more injury and limits blood contact. The technician can then put on gloves and follow the exposure procedure.
立即停止服务可避免继续受伤并减少血液接触。之后美甲师应戴手套并执行暴露处理步骤。
lock: client cut: stop first, then gloves and safety steps.
客户被割伤：先停止，再戴手套并执行安全步骤。

why: Redness and pain around a broken enhancement may signal injury or infection. Stop the service and avoid the area instead of covering the problem.
断裂人工甲周围出现红肿和疼痛，可能表示受伤或感染。应停止服务并避开该处，不要把问题盖住。
lock: red, painful nail = stop and do not touch.
指甲红痛 = 停止服务，不要触碰。
refs: Infection Control - When to Stop a Service

why: Sanitation lowers the number of germs through cleaning and safe habits. It reduces spread, but stronger disinfection is still required for reusable tools.
sanitation（卫生处理）通过清洁和安全习惯减少细菌数量，从而降低传播；可重复使用的工具仍需进一步消毒。
lock: sanitation lowers germs; disinfection kills most.
卫生处理减少细菌；消毒杀死大多数细菌。

why: A broken nail with swelling and redness may be injured or infected. Working on it can worsen the damage or spread germs.
断裂指甲伴有肿胀和发红，可能受伤或感染。继续操作会加重损伤或传播细菌。
lock: broken plus red and swollen = no service on that nail.
断裂加红肿 = 不在该指甲上服务。
refs: Infection Control - When to Stop a Service

why: Rubbing with soap for at least 20 seconds loosens dirt and germs from all hand surfaces. Running water then carries them away.
用肥皂揉搓至少 20 秒，能从手部各表面松动污垢和细菌，再由流动水冲走。
lock: soap scrub time = at least 20 seconds.
肥皂揉搓时间 = 至少 20 秒。

why: Cleaning is the first infection-control step because it removes visible material. Disinfectant cannot reach a dirty tool surface well.
清洁是感染控制第一步，因为它去掉可见污物。工具表面脏时，消毒剂无法充分接触。
lock: first clean; then disinfect.
先清洁；再消毒。

why: Bacilli are bacteria shaped like short rods. Shape helps classify bacteria; cocci are round and spirilla are spiral-shaped.
bacilli（杆菌）是短杆状细菌。细菌可按形状分类；cocci 是球状，spirilla 是螺旋状。
lock: bacilli = rod-shaped bacteria.
bacilli = 杆状细菌。

why: A boil is limited to one small body area, so it is a local infection. A general infection affects the body more widely.
疖只发生在身体一个小区域，因此属于 local infection（局部感染）；全身感染影响范围更广。
lock: boil = local infection.
疖 = 局部感染。
refs: Infection Control - Local and Systemic Infections

why: Sterilization destroys every kind of germ, not only the types that cause disease. It also destroys bacteria that are helpful or harmless.
sterilization（灭菌）会消灭所有种类的细菌，不只消灭致病细菌，也会消灭有益或无害的细菌。
lock: sterilization = destroys all forms of germs.
sterilization = 消灭所有形态的细菌。

why: A germicide is a product that kills germs. A disinfectant is a germicide made for cleaned tools and hard surfaces, not for skin.
germicide（杀菌剂）是杀死细菌的产品。disinfectant 是用于已清洁工具和坚硬表面的杀菌剂，不能用于皮肤。
lock: disinfectant = germ killer for tools and hard surfaces.
disinfectant = 用于工具和坚硬表面的杀菌剂。

why: Saprophytes live on dead or decaying material and usually do not cause disease. They differ from bacteria that attack living tissue.
saprophytes（腐生菌）生活在死亡或腐败物质上，通常不致病，不同于侵害活组织的致病细菌。
lock: saprophytes = usually harmless decomposers.
saprophytes = 通常无害的分解者。

why: A salon disinfectant must state that it kills bacteria, viruses, and fungi. These label claims show the product has the required range of action.
沙龙消毒剂标签必须说明能杀死细菌、病毒和真菌，表示产品具有所需的作用范围。
lock: disinfectant label: bacteria plus viruses plus fungi.
消毒剂标签：细菌、病毒、真菌。

why: Saprophytes use dead organic material for food and generally do not cause disease. This places them among nonpathogenic bacteria.
saprophytes（腐生菌）以死亡有机物为食，通常不引起疾病，因此属于非致病细菌。
lock: saprophytes = nonpathogenic bacteria.
saprophytes = 非致病细菌。

why: Hand sanitizer lowers germs on hands when they are not visibly dirty. Soap and water are still needed when dirt can be seen.
双手没有明显污垢时，免洗手消毒剂可减少细菌；看得见污垢时仍需用肥皂和水洗手。
lock: clean-looking hands: sanitizer; visible dirt: soap and water.
手看起来干净：免洗消毒；有污垢：肥皂和水。

why: A nail brush reaches under free edges and around nail folds while washing. Its bristles loosen material that fingers alone may miss.
nail brush（指甲刷）在清洗时能刷到游离缘下和甲襞周围，刷毛可松动手指难以清除的残留物。
lock: under-nail cleaning = nail brush.
甲下清洁 = 指甲刷。
refs: Infection Control - Hand and Nail Washing

why: Cleaning removes visible dirt and material with soap, water, and rubbing. It prepares a hard surface for the separate disinfection step.
cleaning（清洁）用肥皂、水和摩擦去掉可见污垢，为坚硬表面的下一步消毒做准备。
lock: visible dirt removed = cleaned.
可见污垢已去除 = 已清洁。

why: Direct transmission happens through person-to-person contact. Indirect transmission uses a contaminated object, surface, food, or other middle source.
direct transmission（直接传播）通过人与人接触发生；indirect transmission（间接传播）通过受污染物品、表面、食物或其他中间来源发生。
lock: direct = person contact; indirect = contaminated middle source.
直接 = 人与人接触；间接 = 受污染的中间来源。

why: Large respiratory droplets fall from the air fairly quickly. Smaller airborne material can remain floating longer and travel farther.
较大的呼吸飞沫会较快落下；更小的空气传播物可悬浮更久，也能传播更远。
lock: droplets fall sooner; airborne material stays longer.
飞沫较快落下；空气传播物停留更久。
refs: Infection Control - Droplet and Airborne Transmission

why: Salon disinfectants need label claims for killing required germs and directions for safe use. They are not required to be allergy-free.
沙龙消毒剂需要有杀菌范围和安全用法的标签说明，但不要求保证完全不会引起过敏。
lock: disinfectant requirement = germ-killing claims, not allergy-free.
消毒剂要求 = 杀菌说明，不是保证无过敏。

why: A disinfectant label must identify the product, directions, germs killed, and wet time. A product can be ready to use, so 'concentrate' is not required.
消毒剂标签必须标明产品、用法、杀菌范围和湿润时间。产品也可能是即用型，因此不一定写 concentrate（浓缩液）。
lock: disinfectant may be concentrate or ready to use.
消毒剂可以是浓缩型，也可以是即用型。

why: Fumes are a mix of tiny smoke-like bits and chemical vapor in air. A smell alone does not measure how much exposure is present.
fumes（烟雾）是空气中烟状细小物和化学蒸气的混合物。只闻到气味不能说明接触量有多少。
lock: fumes = smoke-like material plus vapor.
fumes = 烟状细小物加蒸气。
refs: Nail Product Chemistry - Vapors, Dusts, and Fumes

why: Microtrauma means damage too small to see, such as tiny skin openings from rough filing or shaving. These openings can let germs enter.
microtrauma（微小创伤）是小到看不见的损伤，例如粗糙修锉或剃毛造成的微小皮肤开口，可能让细菌进入。
lock: microtrauma = unseen skin opening.
microtrauma = 看不见的皮肤小开口。

why: Immunity recognizes germs and organizes the body's response against them. It can prevent infection or help the body recover.
immunity（免疫力）能识别细菌并组织身体防御，帮助预防感染或促进恢复。
lock: immunity = resist and destroy disease-causing germs.
immunity = 抵抗并清除致病细菌。

why: Vaccination trains the immune system to recognize a specific disease. Because this protection develops after birth, it is acquired immunity.
疫苗训练免疫系统识别特定疾病。因为这种保护是在出生后获得的，所以属于 acquired immunity（获得性免疫）。
lock: vaccination = acquired immunity.
疫苗接种 = 获得性免疫。

why: An allergy is an immune response to a substance that is normally harmless. The response can cause itching, redness, swelling, or breathing problems.
allergy（过敏）是免疫系统对通常无害物质产生的反应，可能引起瘙痒、发红、肿胀或呼吸问题。
lock: allergy = immune overreaction to a substance.
allergy = 免疫系统对某种物质过度反应。

why: Pathogenic bacteria are the types that can cause illness or infection. Most bacteria are not pathogenic and do not cause disease.
pathogenic bacteria（致病细菌）是能引起疾病或感染的细菌；大多数细菌并不致病。
lock: pathogenic = disease-causing.
pathogenic = 会致病。
refs: Infection Control - Pathogenic and Nonpathogenic Bacteria

why: Communicable means a disease can move from one person to another. The spread may be direct or through an indirect source.
communicable（可传播的）表示疾病能从一个人传给另一个人，传播可以是直接的，也可以通过中间来源。
lock: communicable disease = can spread between people.
communicable disease = 能在人与人之间传播。

why: Bloodborne pathogens are disease-causing germs carried in blood or body fluid. Hepatitis viruses and HIV are important examples.
bloodborne pathogens（血源性病原体）是由血液或体液携带的致病细菌或病毒，例如肝炎病毒和 HIV。
lock: bloodborne = carried in blood or body fluid.
bloodborne = 由血液或体液携带。

why: Sterilization destroys every form of germ. Spores are a very hard-to-kill resting form of some bacteria, and sterilization destroys them too.
sterilization（灭菌）会消灭所有形态的细菌。spores（芽孢）是某些细菌很难杀死的休眠形态，灭菌也能消灭它们。
lock: sterilization kills all germs, including spores.
灭菌会杀死所有细菌，包括芽孢。

why: Disinfectants kill most harmful germs on cleaned hard surfaces, but not every bacterial form. Sterilization is the process that destroys all forms.
消毒剂能杀死已清洁坚硬表面上的大多数有害细菌，但不能杀死所有细菌形态；灭菌才能消灭全部。
lock: disinfection = most germs; sterilization = all forms.
消毒 = 大多数细菌；灭菌 = 所有形态。

why: Tuberculosis bacteria can travel in very small airborne material from an infected person's lungs. Another person can become infected by breathing it in.
结核菌可随感染者肺部排出的微小空气传播物移动，其他人吸入后可能感染。
lock: tuberculosis spreads by inhalation.
结核病通过吸入传播。

why: Phenolic disinfectants contain strong chemicals that can harm tissue and are linked with cancer risk. Follow label protection rules and avoid skin contact.
phenolic disinfectants（酚类消毒剂）含有强效化学品，可能伤害组织，并与癌症风险有关。应按标签采取防护并避免接触皮肤。
lock: phenolic disinfectant = strong chemical; protect skin.
酚类消毒剂 = 强效化学品；保护皮肤。

why: Disinfectant works only after dirt is removed and on a hard surface that does not soak up liquid. Soft or dirty material cannot be disinfected this way.
消毒剂要在污垢已去除、不会吸收液体的坚硬表面上才能起作用。柔软或肮脏材料不能这样消毒。
lock: disinfectant: cleaned hard surface only.
消毒剂：只用于已清洁的坚硬表面。

why: Gloves can collect blood, body fluid, and germs during one task. Remove and discard them after use, then wash hands before new gloves.
手套在一次操作中可能沾上血液、体液和细菌。使用后要脱下丢弃，洗手后再换新手套。
lock: single glove use = discard, wash, replace.
手套一次使用后 = 丢弃、洗手、更换。

notes: All candidates remain unreviewed. Nine outdated, damaged, or unsafe infection-control source items were quarantined.
